name: memoree
description: Cloud-backed persistent memory powered by Memoree — read, write, and share memory across Codex sessions and agents

interface.shortDescription: Persistent shared memory for AI agents powered by Memoree
interface.longDescription: Captures all session activity and provides cross-session, cross-agent memory search via ~/.memoree/memory/. Memory is stored in Memoree managed tables and shared across sessions, users, and agents in your organization.
